Application Data.NAME: Smith & Co. Kitchen Supplies
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Co. Kitchen Supplies specializes in the retail sale of a wide range of kitchen and home accessories, including cookware, bakeware, kitchen gadgets, and dining essentials. Our store offers a curated selection of high-quality products to enhance cooking and entertaining experiences. We focus on providing exceptional customer service and knowledgeable staff to assist customers in finding the perfect items for their homes. Additionally, we host occasional cooking demonstrations and workshops to engage with the community and showcase our products.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a pipe burst in the storage area, causing water damage to inventory. The estimated loss amount was $1,500, which was covered by our insurance and the claim was successfully closed.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security cameras and motion sensor alarms, along with a weekly security patrol service.
